title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting
description: Step-by-step reasoning in the prompt improves complex answers; the thinking is visible. Reasoning gets explicit. Answers get better.

demo.code:
print("direct: 55% | CoT: 78% (explicit!)")
print("better: visibly")
_jah_schema = {'technique': 'CoT', 'problem': 'Math', 'strategy': 'Step-by-step', 'evidence': '+20% acc', 'benefit': 'Explicit', 'complexity': 'Low'}
print("technique:", _jah_schema["technique"])
assert set(_jah_schema) == set(['technique', 'problem', 'strategy', 'evidence', 'benefit', 'complexity']) and all(_jah_schema.values())
print("schema verified:", len(_jah_schema), "fields")
